text:
maya: quick heads-up — nightly autotune showed a perf regression after the fp8 kernel path landed on a subset of SM92 cards. attaching notes here.
cheng: which job/commit?
maya: nightly-autotune/seqlen-sweep, commit 3f8a2b. baseline was sm86 fp16 path; new path uses fp8 TC tiled GEMM.
leo: numbers?
maya: p99 token latency +18% at seqlen=2048, batch=8, kv_hit_rate~0.6. throughput down ~12%. small seqlen (<=512) actually improved ~5%.
anita: sounds like seqlen gating issue. did autotuner pick fp8 for all seqlens?
maya: yes, autotune favored fp8 for throughput metric across mixed workloads. it didn’t account for kv cache prefetch overheads on SM92.
srijan: can you paste the profiling snapshot (kernel times + memcpy)?
maya: ```
SM92 fp8_gemm: 12.8ms
kv_prefetch (H->D): 4.5ms
attention_kv_merge: 3.2ms
overall: 21.5ms
baseline SM86 fp16 path overall: 18.3ms
```
cheng: interesting — fp8_gemm is faster but overall slower. where’s the delta?
maya: fp8 path adds reformat + quant/dequant kernels for KV prefetch, and we saw extra shared-memory bank conflicts with the tiled layout on SM92. net effect is more mem traffic and stalls.
leo: naive rule: gate fp8 with `(sm_major*10 + sm_minor) >= 92 && seqlen <= 512 && kv_hit_rate >= 0.8`?
anita: or prefer fp8 when kv_size small && batch large && seqlen <=512 — essentially when compute dominates memory.
srijan: autotuner currently optimizes throughput only. we need to include a memory-bandwidth penalty / end-to-end latency term so it won’t select fp8 where reformat + prefetch hurts net latency.
infra-bot: perf test run 2149999480 started by @maya — results ETA ~15m :hourglass_flowing_sand:
cheng: small patch idea: improve startup capability detection and export flags: `sm_version`, `tensor_cores`, `bf16_supported`, `fp8_experimental` so autotuner rules can read them.
maya: we have detection but drivers (eg driver 537) sometimes report BF16 as supported while runtime paths are broken — need a driver quirk table.
leo: propose runtime fallback matrix: if (sm >= 92 && driver >= 538) enable fp8_fastpath else require runtime demo/handshake pass before selecting fp8.
anita: also add microbench for reformat kernels and kv prefetch bandwidth into CI. and split seqlen buckets (<=64, 65-512, 513-2048, >2048) for autotune states.
srijan: agreed. autotuner should sample per-bucket and include `kv_prefetch_cost ~ bytes_prefetched / measured_bandwidth` in objective.
maya: to reduce blast radius, I'll roll a canary that disables fp8 for seqlen>512 while we iterate.
cheng: please include device PCI id and driver version in perf metadata (was super helpful last time).
maya: will attach perf traces to PERF-4027. thanks :thumbsup:
infra-bot: canary rollout to 10% completed at 2149999620 — canary metrics show p99 back near baseline on those nodes.
leo: nice. follow-up: add a unit test that simulates `kv_hit_rate=0.5` and asserts selection != fp8 for seqlen=2048.
anita: create a follow-up issue PERF-4027 with owners maya, cheng, srijan, leo and ETA EOD tomorrow.
maya: assigning now and adding checklist (autotune metric change, detection flags, driver quirk table, microbench + canary). thanks all :eyes:
